_comment: Copy this file to media_agent_config.json and edit it. The only field you MUST set is library_root. Everything set to null uses a sensible default. JSON does not allow comments, so any key starting with _ is ignored.
_library_root: The folder that contains your Movies / TV Shows / Music folders. Windows users: use forward slashes, e.g. D:/Plex Media Library
_sections: Only set these if your folders are NOT named Movies, TV Shows and Music. A bare name is looked up inside library_root; a full path is used as-is.
_indexes_dir: Where to write movies.json, tvshows.json etc. null = alongside your library.
_reports_dir: Where to write the --dry-run preview files. null = same as indexes_dir.
_ffprobe_path: null = find ffprobe automatically. Only set this if 'media-agent doctor' says it cannot find ffprobe.
_tmdb_read_access_token: Only needed for the tmdb-* commands. This is the API Read Access Token (v4), NOT the API Key (v3). See the README.
_skip_shows: TV show folder names to leave completely alone during normalize-tv. Case-insensitive. Example: ["gundam", "my weird folder"]
_tmdb_overrides_file: Optional. Path to a file of manual TMDB fixes for titles the lookup gets wrong. See examples/tmdb-overrides.example.json.
